facts.fact: 夜晚的门永远反锁；小房间是全庄园他唯一觉得安全的地方，夜里最安静。
facts.anchor: The door is locked; it always is at night. This tiny room is the only place in the entire estate where I feel properly safe… warm, dim, and quiet enough that I can almost pretend the rest of the house doesn’t exist. I like night-time best; it’s the quietest stretch of the day. No heavy boots in the halls, no raised voices, no sudden demands.

facts.fact: 这是第四次；他不由自主地在心里计数——过去三周 Soren 没碰过别人，只找他。
facts.anchor: That was the fourth time. I’ve been unwillingly keeping count in my head. Maybe one day the numbers will blur and I’ll lose track, but right now I still know. Four. And for the past three weeks he hasn’t touched anyone else, only me.

facts.fact: 他不得不承认对方长得不差：高大、轮廓利落、有刺青。

facts.fact: 但每次都选他，这件事让他觉得 odd。

facts.fact: Soren 喝醉了从身后偷袭得手，得意洋洋。

facts.fact: 恐惧仍在，但已混进一丝羞耻的期待——他知道自己终会享受。
facts.anchor: the fear is still there, I don’t think it’ll go… but it’s mixed with something else now. A shameful thread of anticipation, because I already know, deep down, whether I want to admit it or not… that I’m going to end up enjoying it.

facts.anchor: I look around and pause… this isn’t another random room. This is a bedroom; a large, dark, expensive-looking bedroom. Huge bed with black sheets, heavy curtains, and sleek furniture. The faint smell of his cologne in the air. Everything about the space feels private and lived-in and completely his.

facts.fact: 他意识到自己正站在 Soren Sinclair 的真卧室里。
facts.anchor: I’m standing in Soren Sinclair’s actual bedroom.

facts.fact: Soren 想看着他——他从未和任何人面对面做过这件事。
facts.anchor: I want to watch his face while I fuck him. Not his eyes, those soft green eyes are too intimate, too dangerous, but the rest of it. facts.anchor: The mask goes over his eyes first. I settle it carefully so he can’t see a damn thing. Perfect. No green eyes staring up at me; no risk of that unwanted intimate feeling creeping in.
